name: review-cycle
description: Implements the review role's state machine (idle -> scoped -> auditing -> reported) from docs/specs/agent-roles.md: a UserPromptSubmit hook mints a single-use approval token only from the user's own unambiguous turn; a PreToolUse gate refuses the auditing -> reported transition unless every requirement in the review record carries a Present/Surface/Absent/Incorrect verdict AND a matching token is present, evaluated on the target path regardless of which tool performs the write; the same gate stands in every state to refuse reading the building agent's intent, reasoning, or proposal prose.
